Sample Health Plan
Effective January 01, 2025

Table of Contents
Mental Health Care Services ............................ 20
Substance Abuse Services .............................. 21
What Is Not Covered ................................... 30

*TOCLVL2*Mental Health Care Services*TOCLVL2*

Prior authorization is required for all outpatient mental health and substance
use disorder services before benefits are payable.

Inpatient facility services are recommended for patients who are an acute danger
to themselves or others and are provided only during the acute stabilization phase.

Concurrent review is conducted every 3 days for substance use disorder inpatient
stays to confirm continued medical necessity.

A written treatment plan must be submitted for mental health services and updated
every 30 days.

*TOCLVL2*Utilization Management*TOCLVL2*

Precertification is required for all inpatient admissions, both medical/surgical
and behavioral health, regardless of diagnosis.

*TOCLVL2*What Is Not Covered*TOCLVL2*

Wilderness therapy programs are excluded from coverage.

Services provided by an LMFT or LPC are not covered.

Residential treatment room and board is not covered.
